title: High-order geometric-nonlinear readiness audit

supported_bounded_inputs: one homogeneous TET10 or HEX20 family
explicitly_out_of_scope: contact, dynamics, and J2 plasticity claims

LINEAR_STATIC.verification_state: linear evidence exists but is not high-order TL evidence

MODAL.verification_state: consistent mass exists; no nonlinear-modal claim

TOTAL_LAGRANGIAN.verification_state: implemented through common high-order assembly; direct identity V&V missing

INTERNAL_FORCE.verification_state: shared P=F*S integration; independent high-order oracle missing

CONSISTENT_TANGENT.verification_state: combined material and geometric tangent present; finite-difference evidence missing

ENERGY.verification_state: strain-energy path exists; energy-gradient identity unqualified

AFFINE_PATCH.verification_state: non-archived affine smoke only; no analytical oracle

SMALL_LINEAR_LIMIT.verification_state: both routes exist; controlled equivalence fixture missing

STRUCTURAL_CONVERGENCE.verification_state: no qualified high-order TL refinement benchmark

TET10.local_ordering: four corner nodes followed by six edge nodes
TET10.geometry_validation_observed: positive corner orientation and selected TL quadrature-point Jacobians
TET10.readiness_gap: nonlinear curved-geometry quadrature/quality sensitivity requires dedicated fixtures

HEX20.local_ordering: eight corners followed by twelve edge nodes; Gmsh incomplete second-order hexahedron convention
HEX20.geometry_validation_observed: finite positive Jacobians at all 27 integration points
HEX20.readiness_gap: distortion and near-incompressible locking behavior are unqualified

tangent_and_energy_audit.tangent: combined material and geometric tangent, then symmetric assembly
implementation_gaps: no dedicated high-order identity fixture suite
no dedicated high-order nonlinear curved-TET10 quadrature adequacy study
qualification_gaps: no high-order structural convergence or external-correlation evidence

wp04_identity_reuse.policy_note: WP04 excluded TET10/HEX20; no threshold transfers without Owner adoption

targeted_tests.command: python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_tet10_element.py tests/unit/test_hex20_element.py tests/unit/test_geometric_nonlinear_public.py -k 'not tet4 and not requires_six_increments and not rejects_distributed_loads'

direct_readiness_smoke.deformation: one affine state and one rigid z-axis rotation on a canonical straight-sided element
direct_readiness_smoke.interpretation: finite readiness smoke only; not a qualified oracle or threshold source

proposed_sub_work_packages.scope: TET10 identities, integration, and orientation fixtures
HEX20 identities, full integration, and geometry fixtures
HEX20 bounded structural and distortion-sensitive benchmark
cross-family bounded comparison and Owner review

benchmark_design.benchmark_A: high-order cantilever with nodal dead end loads; declared 4x1x1, 8x2x2, and 16x4x4 base-cell refinement levels
benchmark_design.benchmark_B: mapped quarter-cantilever; declared 4x1x1, 8x2x1, and 16x4x2 arc/radial/thickness levels
freeze_before_execution: tip displacement, reactions, reaction moment, min_detF, energy/work observables

validation_limits: No qualification of curved TET10 nonlinear quadrature adequacy
No qualification of stress recovery, locking, contact, dynamics, J2 plasticity, mixed meshes, or mixed materials
No formulation, solver, or maturity change
No full regression or large numerical campaign
